text: Betano's parent, Kaizen Gaming, is privately held. Per Allwyn's own press release, OPAP Investment Limited, 'a wholly owned subsidiary of OPAP S.A.,' transferred its 36.75% minority interest in Kaizen Gaming's Betano business (outside Greece and Cyprus) to Allwyn Investments Cyprus Limited, 'a fully owned indirect subsidiary of Allwyn International a.s.'; no state or state-fund owner is named.

source.name: Allwyn: Transfer of OPAP's minority stake in the Betano Business
source.quote: transferred today its 36.75% minority interest in the business activities of Kaizen Gaming Limited outside Greece and Cyprus (the "Betano Business") to Allwyn Investments Cyprus Limited
